# `csharp_space_after_semicolon_in_for_statement`

Space after a semicolon in a for statement.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

### `csharp_space_after_semicolon_in_for_statement = true`

```ini
csharp_space_after_semicolon_in_for_statement = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Sum(int n)
    {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0;i < n;i++)
            total += i;
        return total;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Sum(int n)
    {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            total += i;
        return total;
    }
}
```
:::

::::
